Family

I married my high school girlfriend after I got out of the Marine Corps. A couple years later in 2008 we had our son Kris, and in 2011 we had our daughter Keira. It has been a blessing to raise two best friends with my best friend. Both our kids are amazingly talented — our son is an incredible athlete who loves wrestling and MMA, while our daughter is a natural performer and musician who plays guitar, sings, and has taken on leading roles in multiple musicals.
